743899565b.substituent_description: Fused bicyclic: a six-membered ring containing one ring N and drawn with an aromatic circle, fused to a five-membered ring containing an N that carries Ac. In the six-ring, going round from the fusion carbon that is bonded to N(Ac): CH, ring N, C bearing OMe (adjacent to the ring N), CH, then the other fusion carbon. In the five-ring: N(Ac), the CH bearing EtOOC (adjacent to N(Ac)), a CH2 vertex, and the two fusion carbons.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: dark ink blobs at the vertex bearing EtOOC and at the vertex bearing OMe (not wedges)
743899565b.notes: No double bonds drawn other than the aromatic circle. The five-ring vertex between the EtOOC carbon and the fusion carbon is a plain CH2 vertex with no label.

69cefac752.substituent_description: A benzene ring (circle) bearing OPh at the top vertex and, at the lower-left vertex, a CH2 group: this is meta (1,3) to the OPh. The CH2 is bonded to a chain CH that carries NHBoc (vertical bond upward) and MeOOC (hashed bond to the lower left).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: hashed bond lines run right up against the C of MeOOC
the two O letters of MeOOC are heavily retraced
69cefac752.notes: Hashed bond is drawn as about five short parallel strokes from the chain CH to MeOOC. The chain is ring-CH2-CH(NHBoc)(MeOOC).

4e89d6d1bb.substituent_description: Purine-type fused six/five ring system drawn with alternating double bonds: the carbon between the two six-ring N atoms carries COOtBu, the carbon at the opposite lower-left side carries H2N, and the five-ring N at the bottom of the six-ring junction (right five-ring N) is bonded by a solid wedge to a cyclohexane carbon. On the cyclohexane, the carbon adjacent to the N-bearing carbon carries BocNH by a hashed bond, and the carbon 1,4 (para) to the N-bearing carbon carries a hashed bond to CH2-CO2H.
4e89d6d1bb.notes: Typeset structure. Four double bonds are all inside the fused heteroaromatic bicycle. COOtBu and CO2H are written condensed with no drawn C=O.

003b281edc.substituent_description: Left to right: pyrrolidine ring N bonded to a C(=O) that is bonded to NH; NH-CH2CH2 linked to one N of a piperazine ring; the other piperazine N is bonded to a para-disubstituted benzene (circle) whose para position carries O-CH2, and that CH2 is bonded by a hashed bond to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane (two ring O). The dioxolane C2 carries a 2,4-dichlorophenyl ring (circle, Cl ortho and Cl para to the attachment point) and a hashed bond to a CH2 that leads to the N1 of an imidazole ring.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: hashed bonds are scribbly hatch marks, count of strokes unclear
imidazole double-bond positions are small and close together
the two Cl labels are cursive and the l is tall
003b281edc.notes: Double bonds counted: urea C=O, and two inside the imidazole ring. The aromatic rings are drawn as circles except the imidazole, which has alternating double bonds.

ab90ded6b9.substituent_description: Fused five/six bicycle: the five-ring has N-Me and a carbon bearing I adjacent to that N; the six-ring has a ring N, a C=N, a second ring N and a C=O. That second ring N is bonded through a CH2 to C4 of a piperidine ring, which carries HO on the same carbon and whose N is acylated by a C(=O). The C(=O) is bonded by a solid wedge to C4 of a second piperidine whose neighbouring carbon C3 carries Ph by a hashed bond, and whose N carries Boc.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: double-bond line pairs in the fused bicycle are drawn close together
ab90ded6b9.notes: Double bonds counted: N=C and C=O in the six-ring, the fusion C=C, the C=C next to the I-bearing carbon, and the amide C=O. The HO piperidine carbon is quaternary (HO and CH2 on the same vertex).

abab5cb525.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (circle) has S at the right vertex and AcNH at the lower-left vertex, meta (1,3) to each other. S has two double-bonded O (one above, one below) and is bonded to N, which carries CH2-Bn and a CH2 leading to C(=O)-NH-N=CH. The CH is attached to C3/C4 of a pyrrole with a methyl stick on each carbon next to the ring N (2,5-dimethyl); the pyrrole N is bonded to a benzene ring (circle) carrying unlabelled methyl sticks at ortho and para to the N.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: the n of Bn looks like a cursive r
methyl groups are drawn as bare sticks with no label
abab5cb525.notes: Double bonds counted: two S=O, one C=O, one N=C of the hydrazone, and two C=C in the pyrrole. No E/Z label written.

c9a3df35bd.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (circle) has Cl at one vertex and the five-membered ring N at the para vertex (4-chlorophenyl). The five-ring is N(aryl)-N=C(NH-Ar)-NH-C(=O): the C=O carbon is bonded to N(aryl) and to ring NH, and the C=N carbon bears an exocyclic NH linked to a second benzene ring (circle) that has CO2H at the para position relative to that NH.
c9a3df35bd.notes: Double bonds counted: the C=O and the C=N inside the five-ring. The five-ring has no circle.

5fa2ce62c7.substituent_description: Spiro compound: a pyrrolidine ring with N-Boc shares its spiro carbon with a five-membered lactam ring that also contains C(=O), N and two carbons of a fused benzene ring (circle). The lactam N carries a CH2 bonded to a second benzene ring (circle) that has OCH3 at the para position relative to the CH2.
5fa2ce62c7.notes: OCH3 is written vertically with O above CH3. The only double bond drawn is the lactam C=O.
